cs.t: > When my PS4 Pro is playing stuff like TLOU2, it sounds like it's going to start hovering off my TV cabinet. I have the CUH-7200 PS4 Pro model which is apparently the quietest model and it's insane how loud that thing gets when I played TLOU2. The copying times for updates/patches is equally bad with downloading taking a few minutes and copying times taking more than 20mins. There's clearly alot of room for improvement - At least Sony have realised this as the PS5 will have a SSD instead of a HDD.
cs.th: Playstation's secret weapon: a nearly all-automated factory
